note: PROVISIONAL. Chosen by Claude to render a first pass under RFC 0025, not by the author. The setting (place, date, year), the art direction and every alt line below are the author's to change; the game's own text fixes none of them.

setting.place: Brekka and Halde are fictional. Rendered on a coast at 62.0 N, 5.5 E, UTC+2.
setting.date: The October crossing, rendered as the night of 2023-10-13 to 14. The year is arbitrary: the text names the month, not the year.
why: The crossing runs 20:00 to 06:00 in October (README; state.py); the last boat in March uses the same five places and, by the RFC's default of one still per location, the same stills.
At that latitude and date every hour of the crossing is after dusk, so the outdoor still is lit by the deck lamps, the stern light and Strata's synthetic moon.
The year is left open by the text, but a passenger has a laptop (the saloon menu), so a present-day year was used.

artDirection: Flat-coloured Strata primitives, no textures; one still per location; no people drawn (the characters are written, not drawn - RFC 0025 non-goal).

saloon.alt: The saloon at night under blue lamps: rows of reclining seats, some with company blankets over them, dark windows, a shuttered bar, and the purser's hatch lit warm at the far end.

cardeck.alt: The car deck under cold strip lights: cars parked nose to tail in two lanes between yellow lines, and a white van with its back doors open on blue fish boxes.

corridor.alt: The cabin corridor: a narrow carpeted passage with cabin doors on both sides, a red fire-hose box, the pantry door lit, and at the far end the door of cabin 6 with a white card in its slot.

deck.alt: The open deck astern at night: the stern rail and a lifebuoy in the foreground, the pale wake spreading behind the ship over black water, and one small light on the horizon.

wheelhouse.alt: The dark wheelhouse: the green glow of the radar on the console under the forward windows, the lit binnacle on its pedestal, and the chart table under a red lamp.
